what_this_is: Local parity check of the final real run against Microsoft Agent Framework's declarative engine. Scripted agents, no model, no Azure call. Not Foundry execution evidence.

checks.check: the local engine ran the v10 definition without a failed action
all nine scripted replies equal the text the platform stored for that agent
every action the hosted service reported also ran locally
those actions ran in the same order
both took the branch through node-release-approved-message
both took the branch through node-followup-handoff
the local engine took no branch the hosted run skipped
the local engine released exactly one customer message
that message is character for character what the hosted service released
the evidence folder was not touched
